tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang dbyer med pa'i lam zab nyams su len tshul tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa zhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye/

'dir slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang dbyer med pa'i lam zab nyams su len par 'dod pas bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stang gis 'dug ste/ na mo/ bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du// bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrub nas ni// gang la gang 'dul 'phrin las kyis// 'gro ba bsgral bar dam bca' 'o// lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas/ rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams chen por gsal ba'i mdun phyogs su yid bzhin gyi rgya mtsho chen po sngo zhing dwangs la yangs shing dri ma med pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma'i sdong po lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba/ de'i dbus su rang gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas ā tsarya gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhi zhing khro la 'dzum zhing yid du 'ong ba spyan nyi zla 'khyil ba/ zhal nas gsang sngags zab mo'i chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas thugs khar 'dzin pa/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng du mtshan ldan gyi ka pā la 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga yod pa/ dbu skra nag cing snum pa'i lcang lo 'phyang ba/ dbu la sha ba'i snyan zhu gsol ba/ de la rgod kyi rtse rgyal btsugs pa/ dngul dkar gyi me long dang gser gyi nyi zla dang rdo rje'i tog gis mtshan pa/ dar chen sna lnga'i phod kyis brgyan pa/ sku la rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang gos mthing nag dar gyi phod kha gsol ba/

de'i steng du chos gos ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan dmar po la gser gyi pa ṭa ris yod pa mnabs pa/ de'i phyir khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i phyir zab ber smug khra gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'khor du rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang*/ grub chen bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa/ me tog gi char 'bab cing rol mo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ snang srid thams cad bkrag dang mdangs su mer re ba/ 'ja' dang 'od du 'khyil ba cig gyur/ bla ma de'i spyir bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas nub phyogs o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang rnga yab dpal ri'i rtse mo/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i gnas mchog dang phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas slob dpon chen po 'khor dang bcas pa kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa ltar byon nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun gyi de nyid la thim pas de dag gis bdag la dgyes pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa brtse ba'i thugs rjes dgongs/ 'dzum pa'i zhal nas rigs kyi bu dang*/ rigs kyi bu mo khyed rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las ngas sgrol/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la ngas bkod/ 'di phyi bar do'i skyabs gnas ngas byed/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad ngas btsal lo// zhes gsung lhang lhang yod par bsam la/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad ltos med du phul/ snying gi dkyil rkang gi khong nas mos gus kyi gdung shug drag pos glo snying brang gsum spyi bo mthil bzhi btang nas kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par gsol ba 'di ltar btab ste/ e ma ho/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// 'od dpag med pa chos sku bde ba che// lho phyogs po ta la yi ri bo'i spor// spyan ras gzigs dbang longs sku thugs rje can// u rgyan rnga yab dpal ri'i pho brang rtser// padma 'byung gnas grub dbang sprul pa'i sku// da ltar bod yul kha ba can ljongs na// bka' drin mnyam med drin chen chos kyi rje// sku gsum dbyer med bla ma rin po cher// gsol ba 'debs so bdag brgyud byin gyis rlobs// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dang*// snyigs dus nyams thag bod yul skye dgu'i tshogs// khyad par bdag dang bdag la ltos pa rnams// brtse chen thugs rje'i spyan gyis dbyings nas gzigs// rgyal dbang khyod kyis bslu med rdo rje'i gsung*// dad ldan mi re'i mdun na pad 'byung re/

rtag par bzhugs shing byin gyis brlabs pa dang*// khyad par yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus kyi tshe// mngon gsum byon nas rjes su 'dzin no zhes// 'gyur med bden pa'i zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar// snying nas dad pas gsol ba 'debs lags na// da lta nyid du rjes su bzung du gsol// 'di phyi bar do rnam pa thams cad du// legs nyes skyid sdug mtho dman ci byung yang*// skyabs mgon re sa gzhan nas mi tshol bas// 'du 'bral med par thugs rjes rtag tu skyongs// 'khrul snang mun par khyams pa'i 'khor ba 'dir// ye shes thugs rjes nyi 'od kyis gsal te// ka dag bde ba chen po'i dbyings nyid du// da lta rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa bla ma sku gsum gyi gsol 'debs le'u bdun pa la sogs skabs su gang bab kyis gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ de nas 'dzab bzla bar 'dod pas slar yang gu ru rin po che de nyid kyi thugs kar yid mig rlung gsum rtse gcig tu gtad nas/ byang chub ma thob bar du khyed mkhyen snyam pa'i mos gus kyi gdung shug drag po byas pas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'ja' tshon shar ba lta bu'i sna la badzra gu ru'i sngags kyi phreng ba rang sgra drag po 'u ru ru sgrogs pa/ nyi zer gyi rdul bzhin du bun gyis 'phros/ rang gi spyi bo dang mgrin pa snying kha la sogs pa'i lus kyi cha shas thams cad nas mtsho la char chen po 'bab pa bzhin sib sib thim pas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bar du gcod pa thams cad skad gcig de nyid la sangs kyis dag bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ gu ru'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres par bsam la sems gzhan du ma yengs pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: zhes pa brgya stong la sogs pa ci nus bzlas par bya/ skabs 'gar 'dzab dbyangs dang bcas ci rigs par bskul lo// thun grol mtshams/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje bla ma drin chen chos kyi rje// padma 'byung gnas rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// gsol ba 'debs so mchog dang thun mong gi// dngos grub thams cad da lta nyid du stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ gu ru de nyid brtse ba'i thugs rjes spyan nam mkha'i mthong su hrig hrig gzigs pas snang srid thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyi rang bzhin du mer gyis zhu nas gu ru nyid la thim/ de nyid kyang 'ja' dang 'od kyi rang bzhin khra mer gyis rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas rang dang dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur nas gdangs 'gags pa med pa 'ja' dang 'od du gsal le ba/ gshis stong nyid chos sku rjen ne ba/ ngo bo bde chen rtsol bsgrub med pa'i ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag go / mthar/ skye ba kun tu sogs/ bsngo ba smon lam bkris spyi ltar bya'o// da lta'i dus 'dir kha ba can ljongs kyi// 'gro ba kun la rgyal ba thams cad pas// ches cher byin rlabs myur du grub pa'i rje// padma 'byung gnas zhabs dang bla ma mchog /dbyer med bsgrub pa'i zab lam snying khu 'o// sngon tshe thub dbang zhabs sen nor bu 'od// gtsug gi pad mor gus mchod ma gha dha// bzang mo zhes grags byang phyogs 'dir 'ong pa// bstan dang bla ma gtsug rgyan nor bu'i spor// 'du 'bral med par gus mchod mi'i dbang po// gang de'i gsung gis bskul nas nyams bzhes su// pad mas rjes bzung bandes sbyar ba dge// bkris zhal bzang*// // rdo rje 'chang chen grub chen brgyad cu bzhi// padma 'byung gnas rje 'bangs nyer lnga dang*// rtsa brgyud bla ma grub thob rgya mtsho la// phyag 'tshal mchod pas skyabs pa'i gsol ba 'debs// thugs rje chen po rigs bzhi'i spyan ras gzigs// bskal ba bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis// rgya mtsho lnga yi lha tshogs thams cad la// phyag 'tshal= /maktsa rnams kyi ston pa shākya thub// gnas brtan bcu drug dge bsnyen dharmā tā// byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa thams cad la// phyag 'tshal=

/kun bzang rigs lnga yab yum thub pa drug /sems dpa' sems ma sgo ba yab yum brgyad// zhi ba buddha bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la// phyag 'tshal= /che mchog rigs lnga khrag 'thung yab dang yum// ke seng sgo ba dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad// khrag 'thung 'bar ba lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la// phyag 'tshal= /dkon mchog gsum gyi mtshan sngags nas/ phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
